create_HFSummaryWriter: create an HFSummaryWriter instance to push tensorboard training logs to a Hugging Face Hub repo
create_HFSummaryWriter_context: create an HFSummaryWriter with context manager to auto-push logs every N minutes and on exit
create_HFSummaryWriter_custom_path: create an HFSummaryWriter with custom logdir, commit frequency, and repo path in Hugging Face Hub
create_HFSummaryWriter_squash: create an HFSummaryWriter that squashes repo history after each commit to prevent repo bloat
create_HFSummaryWriter_tags: create an HFSummaryWriter that auto-tags the model card with hf-summary-writer on initialization
